يختبرون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَبِرُونَ (yaḵtabirūna) /jax.ta.bi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# يُخْتَبَرُونَ (yuḵtabarūna) /jux.ta.ba.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
